title: Letter from the Red Ford
author: Wendric Fallowmere, Billman
pages: Dear Mother. We are camped at the Red Ford where the old legion fort stands. They say an emperor's army died here once. You can still find bones in the bank when the river is low. I do not look.
The Ashborn company riding with us are called the Iron Tusks. They are not what the priests said. Their captain shares her food with our sick and sings to her horse. Do not tell Flamekeeper Cedwin.
The lord has not paid them since Highsun. Their captain told me plainly: under their law, if he does not pay, they may take what they are owed from the land. I think she was warning me.
Tell Edlyn I kept the ribbon. Keep my candle lit at the Vigil whether I come home or not. If I do not, plant something by the gate. I would rather be a tree than a stone.
Postscript, in another hand. The company was paid in the end, with the lord's own silver plate. Your son is well and asks for socks. Mazhra of the Iron Tusks, who writes better than he does.
